product.description: Extend the reach of your HDMI® connection using this Commercial Series Premium High Speed HDMI Extension Cable from Monoprice!This High Speed HDMI Cable supports the following general features:18Gbps data throughputCL2 in-wall fire safety rating24AWG copper conductorsGold plated connectorsIt supports the following HDMI features:1080p resolution at 120Hz4K resolution at 60Hz3D videoAudio Return ChannelDeep Color up to 16-bits per channelx.v.Color™High Definition Audio, including SA-CD, DVD-Audio, DTS-HD Master Audio™, and Dolby TrueHD™NOTE: The High Speed rating of this cable is contingent on the total length and gauge of the cable as a whole, including both the extension and the original cable. As long as both the extension and the original are at least 24 AWG and the total length is 15 feet or less, the High Speed rating can be maintained. With thinner cables and/or longer runs, the cable can be rated only as a Standard HDMI Cable.TIP: It is a good idea to test cables and connections before installing them inside a wall.
